localChanges: Computer players now build an army that suits their leader: a militaristic leader builds more attackers while a weaker rival is within reach, and a civilized one fewer while there's none (closes #424).
Computer players take on one enemy at a time, their neighbours first, and can gather an army in port and ship it across the sea to attack a weaker enemy's cities.
Expansionist computer players send some of their Settlers to found cities overseas once their own land starts filling up (closes #374).
Computer players' ships no longer sit inside a port city where no one can board them, so explorers and Settlers waiting to go overseas are picked up.

log: For civ-clone/web-renderer#424: scales how many attackers a computer player wants, given the weaker player without peace it could reach, or null.
ArmySize (civ-clone/web-renderer#424): Militaristic leaders keep twice the attackers while they have a weaker rival in reach, Civilized leaders half as many while they have none.
chore: range on base-leader-personality ^0.1.2 for ArmySize and OverseasSettlers

For civ-clone/web-renderer#424. `lib/Player/rivals.ts` finds a player's rival: an enemy (no peace treaty) weaker than it, by core-power's military power with the leader's `AttackConfidence`, with a known city it could reach by land or by ferry. The attackers a city wants are scaled by the leader's `ArmySize` for that rival, and only enemies' cities and units give it something to attack.

For civ-clone/web-renderer#374. A new passenger role, 'invader': an attacker with no enemy city it can reach and nothing to explore at home goes for a known enemy city on another landmass, where the owner's units there are weaker than the player's power with its leader's `AttackConfidence`. Up to `INVADERS` (4) share a target, so a ferry sails loaded; other roles keep one passenger per target. The `invadeOverseas` mission comes after `exploreLand`.
For civ-clone/web-renderer#374, found tracing invaders that waited in port for dozens of turns:

a transport in the port city found no path to the sea beside it (the path finder starts on land), so it stayed in the city, where passengers can't embark, and kept the port claimed from other transports. It now takes the one step out.
a port with passengers waiting didn't build a transport while the player had an empty one anywhere, even on another sea. Only one that could sail alongside the port counts now.

For civ-clone/web-renderer#374: `sailTo` let `moveUnit` wander on with the moves left once the ship reached its berth, and it usually went back into the port city, where passengers can't embark. It now stops at the end of its path and waits there.
For civ-clone/web-renderer#374, after Dom's direction on the issue:
`rivalOf` is a campaign focus: kept while it's still a rival, the nearest one with a city on the player's landmasses before any overseas, and an overseas focus gives way to one next door.

invasions go only for the focus's cities, and invaders gather in port until their attack is `MUSTER` (2) × the defence on the target's landmass (with `AttackConfidence`), or they've waited `MUSTER_WAIT` (15) turns. Up to `INVADERS` (8) go for one city, and a ferry with invaders sails once all of them are aboard.
a port builds transports while its waiting passengers outnumber the room on the empty transports that could reach it and those on order.

For civ-clone/web-renderer#374: a ferry unloaded invaders beside a coast held by the enemy, where they had nowhere to step, and with nothing to do they were offered the same turn until the turn's action limit. The landing is now beside land with no other player's city or units on it, and `TravelOverseas` also takes any land unit at sea: a passenger waits for its ship, and any other goes ashore if it can and otherwise waits.

For civ-clone/web-renderer#374: the share `OverseasSettlers` gives (Civ1: Expansionist 0.5) of a player's founders, picked by unit id so the same ones each turn, go for a city site overseas before they look for one at home. The rest go overseas once home is full, as before.

For civ-clone/web-renderer#374: `moveUnit` could keep choosing, for a land unit at sea, a move that left its moves as they were, looping for ever within the one action (seed 44 of the arena hung). It now disembarks onto a neighbour if it can, and otherwise waits.

For civ-clone/web-renderer#374 (Dom): sent while there was still plenty of room at home, Expansionists founded fewer cities in all (arena: −1.1 cities on seeds 1–40). The `OverseasSettlers` share now goes overseas only once the founder's landmass has fewer than `SCARCE_SITES` (6) sites left. Also counting a landmass shared with another player still cost them cities.
